questions.title: CSV 字段类型
questions.prompt: 用 csv.DictReader 读取一行 name,Ada 与 score,90 后，row["score"] 默认是什么？
questions.explanation: CSV 是文本格式，reader 默认返回字符串字段；需要 int(row["score"]) 才恢复整数。
questions.hint: 官方文档说明 reader 默认不自动做数据类型转换。
questions.attribution: 依据 Python csv 官方文档编写

questions.title: 追踪 DictReader 输出
questions.code:
import csv
import io

text = "name,score\nAda,90\n"
row = next(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text)))
score = int(row["score"])
print(row["name"], score, type(score).__name__)
questions.explanation: DictReader 先得到字符串字段；int() 转换后 score 是整数，因此类型名是 int。
questions.hint: 分别追踪姓名、转换后的值和类型名。
questions.attribution: 依据 csv.DictReader 行为原创

questions.title: 保存并重新加载成绩
questions.prompt: 实现 save_scores(path, records) 和 load_scores(path)。CSV 列为 name、score；使用 UTF-8、newline="" 和字典读写器。读取时把 score 转回 int；文件不存在时返回 []。网站不执行代码，请在本地调用测试。
questions.answer:
import csv

FIELDS = ["name", "score"]

def save_scores(path, records):
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as file:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(file, fieldnames=FIELDS)
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(records)

def load_scores(path):
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as file:
            reader = csv.DictReader(file)
            return [{"name": row["name"], "score": int(row["score"])} for row in reader]
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return []
questions.explanation: 保存时始终写表头；加载时在 with 块内读取并恢复整数类型，只精确处理文件不存在这一种预期情况。
questions.hint: DictWriter 先 writeheader，再 writerows；load 只捕获 FileNotFoundError。
questions.attribution: 依据 Python 官方 csv API 原创，非官方原题
